source: Advanced short story written in spoken Palestinian by Claude. NOT native-validated.

sentences.ar: بآخر الحارة، كان في بيت قديم مهجور.
sentences.en: At the end of the neighborhood, there was an old abandoned house.
The kids were afraid to go near it.

sentences.ar: كانوا يقولوا إنه مسكون وفيه أشباح.
sentences.en: They used to say it was haunted and had ghosts.

sentences.ar: أنا كنت فضولي، وحبيت أعرف الحقيقة.
sentences.en: I was curious, and wanted to know the truth.

sentences.ar: يوم، جمعت شجاعتي وقربت من البيت.
sentences.en: One day, I gathered my courage and approached the house.

sentences.ar: الباب كان مفتوح شوي، فدخلت بحذر.
sentences.en: The door was slightly open, so I entered cautiously.

sentences.ar: جوا، كان في غبار وعناكب وأثاث قديم.
sentences.en: Inside, there was dust, spiders, and old furniture.

sentences.ar: بس ما كان في أشباح، بس ذكريات قديمة.
sentences.en: But there were no ghosts, only old memories.

sentences.ar: لقيت صور معلقة عالحيط لعيلة زمان.
sentences.en: I found pictures hung on the wall of a family from long ago.

sentences.ar: عرفت إنه البيت كان مليان حياة ومحبة.
sentences.en: I realized the house had been full of life and love.

sentences.ar: سألت جدي عن هالبيت، فحكالي قصته.
sentences.en: I asked my grandfather about this house, and he told me its story.

sentences.ar: قال إنه أهله سافروا برا وما رجعوا.
sentences.en: He said its people traveled abroad and never returned.

sentences.ar: حسيت بحزن على بيت نساه أهله.
sentences.en: I felt sad for a house forgotten by its people.

sentences.ar: من يومها، ما عدت أخاف منه.
sentences.en: From that day, I was no longer afraid of it.

sentences.ar: عرفت إنه أكتر شي مخيف، هو النسيان.
sentences.en: I learned that the scariest thing is being forgotten.
